name: Paper atlas
description: History and places in cut paper: parchment maps, red routes, dated labels and polaroid evidence.
rules: Parchment background, crimson routes and stamps, ink-brown text.
A map or a timeline in most shots; routes draw themselves as the place is named.
Dates are labels (mono), places are labels (serif italic).
Polaroids and case cards for real photos and documents, with sources named.
camera_language: No camera; slow zoom on maps.
typography: Serif italic for places, mono for dates.
audio_direction: calm bed, paper slide whooshes, stamp on dates
pitfalls: Modern UI mixed into a paper look.
Too many labels crossing the route.
